title: Bongaon Bazar — Authentic Village Heritage
description: Bringing pure, homemade, hygienically packed village delicacies from Bongaon to urban families and loved ones of Probashis across Bangladesh.
storyParagraph1: Bongaon Bazar started with a simple promise: preserving traditional Bengali flavors in clean, modern packaging. Instead of mass-produced alternatives, we source small-batch shutki vorta, sun-dried achar, and pure ghee crafted by trusted village artisans.
storyParagraph2: For Bangladeshis living abroad, sending authentic homemade food to parents and family back home shouldn't require international cards or complicated logins. That is why we offer 100% Cash on Delivery across Bangladesh within 4–7 business days.
pillar1Desc: Prepared in small batches using traditional recipes with zero artificial preservatives or colors.
pillar2Desc: Food-grade sealed jars and vacuum pouches that lock in freshness and aroma during transit.
pillar3Desc: Order easily from abroad and let your family in Bangladesh pay cash upon parcel arrival.
ctaTitle: Ready to taste authentic village flavors?
ctaDesc: Explore our curated shutki vorta, homemade achar, ghee, and Probashi family combos.
